question: In the United States, for Q4 2019 and Q4 2020, first select only those cities where total sales (with no promotions) rose by at least 20% from Q4 2019 to Q4 2020. Among these cities, rank products by their overall sales (still excluding promotions) in those quarters and take the top 20%. Then compute each top product’s share of total sales in Q4 2019 and Q4 2020 and calculate the difference in share from Q4 2019 to Q4 2020, returning the results in descending order of that share change.
sql:
-- Step 4: For top 20% products, compute share of total sales in Q4 2019 and Q4 2020
WITH city_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        c.cust_city,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_year = 2019 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) as sales_2019,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_year = 2020 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) as sales_2020
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
        AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
        AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
        AND s.promo_id = 999
    GROUP BY c.cust_city
),
qualifying_cities AS (
    SELECT cust_city
    FROM city_sales
    WHERE sales_2019 > 0
        AND sales_2020 >= sales_2019 * 1.2
),
product_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        s.prod_id,
        p.prod_name,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN products p ON s.prod_id = p.prod_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
        AND c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualifying_cities)
        AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
        AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
        AND s.promo_id = 999
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, p.prod_name
),
top_products AS (
    SELECT prod_id, prod_name, total_sales
    FROM product_sales
    WHERE prod_id IN (
        SELECT prod_id
        FROM product_sales
        QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) <= CAST(COUNT(*) OVER () * 0.2 AS INTEGER)
    )
),
-- Total sales per quarter in qualifying cities
quarter_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        t.calendar_year,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_quarter_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
        AND c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualifying_cities)
        AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
        AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
        AND s.promo_id = 999
    GROUP BY t.calendar_year
),
-- Product sales per quarter in qualifying cities
product_quarter_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        s.prod_id,
        t.calendar_year,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as product_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
        AND c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualifying_cities)
        AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
        AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
        AND s.promo_id = 999
        AND s.prod_id IN (SELECT prod_id FROM top_products)
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, t.calendar_year
)
SELECT 
    tp.prod_id,
    tp.prod_name,
    pqs_2019.calendar_year as year_2019,
    pqs_2019.product_sales as sales_2019,
    qt_2019.total_quarter_sales as total_2019,
    1.0 * pqs_2019.product_sales / qt_2019.total_quarter_sales as share_2019,
    pqs_2020.calendar_year as year_2020,
    pqs_2020.product_sales as sales_2020,
    qt_2020.total_quarter_sales as total_2020,
    1.0 * pqs_2020.product_sales / qt_2020.total_quarter_sales as share_2020,
    1.0 * pqs_2020.product_sales / qt_2020.total_quarter_sales - 1.0 * pqs_2019.product_sales / qt_2019.total_quarter_sales as share_change
FROM top_products tp
JOIN product_quarter_sales pqs_2019 ON tp.prod_id = pqs_2019.prod_id AND pqs_2019.calendar_year = 2019
JOIN product_quarter_sales pqs_2020 ON tp.prod_id = pqs_2020.prod_id AND pqs_2020.calendar_year = 2020
JOIN quarter_totals qt_2019 ON qt_2019.calendar_year = 2019
JOIN quarter_totals qt_2020 ON qt_2020.calendar_year = 2020
ORDER BY share_change DESC
